mapper.sql: SELECT i.order_item_id,SUM(i.quantity) quantity FROM crm_shipment_item i JOIN crm_shipment h ON h.id=i.shipment_id WHERE h.status='POSTED' GROUP BY i.order_item_id

FROM crm_order_delivery d JOIN crm_sales_order s ON s.id=d.order_id JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=s.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=d.manager_id LEFT JOIN sys_user p ON p.id=d.production_id LEFT JOIN sys_user w ON w.id=d.warehouse_id

CASE WHEN s.status='CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN s.status='COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_sales_order_item i LEFT JOIN () sent ON sent.order_item_id=i.id WHERE i.order_id=s.id AND i.active=1 AND i.quantity>COALESCE(sent.quantity,0)) THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_shipment h WHERE h.order_id=s.id AND h.status='POSTED') THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE d.preparation END

SELECT d.*,s.order_no,s.status order_status,s.customer_id,s.opportunity_id,s.version order_version,c.company_name customer_name, c.owner_id,o.dept_id owner_dept_id,o.real_name owner_name,m.real_name manager_name,p.real_name production_name,w.real_name warehouse_name, s.promised_date,s.requested_date,s.recipient_name,s.recipient_phone,s.shipping_address, () status,(s.promised_date<CURRENT_DATE AND s.status='CONFIRMED' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM crm_sales_order_item i LEFT JOIN () sent ON sent.order_item_id=i.id WHERE i.order_id=s.id AND i.active=1 AND i.quantity>COALESCE(sent.quantity,0))) overdue

WHERE s.deleted=0 AND s.status IN('CONFIRMED','COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND (s.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR c.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%') OR m.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.keyword},'%')) AND ()=#{query.status} AND s.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.promised_date<CURRENT_DATE AND () NOT IN('SHIPPED','COMPLETED')
mapper.select: ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT i.id,i.sku_id,i.product_name,i.sku_code,i.specification,i.requirements,i.unit,i.quantity,COALESCE(sent.quantity,0) shipped_quantity FROM crm_sales_order_item i LEFT JOIN () sent ON sent.order_item_id=i.id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId} AND i.active=1 ORDER BY i.sort_no
SELECT e.*,u.real_name actor_name FROM crm_delivery_event e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=e.actor_id WHERE e.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY e.id DESC
SELECT id,real_name,employee_no,dept_id,status,employment_status,deleted FROM sys_user WHERE status=1 AND employment_status=1 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id
mapper.sql: SELECT h.*,u.real_name actor_name,s.order_no,c.company_name customer_name FROM crm_shipment h JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=h.actor_id JOIN crm_sales_order s ON s.id=h.order_id JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=s.customer_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_shipment WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
WHERE h.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY h.id DESC
SELECT * FROM crm_shipment_item WHERE shipment_id=#{id} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_shipment SET status='VOID',void_reason=#{reason} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: FROM crm_shipment h JOIN crm_order_delivery d ON d.order_id=h.order_id JOIN crm_sales_order s ON s.id=h.order_id JOIN crm_customer c ON c.id=s.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user o ON o.id=c.owner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user m ON m.id=d.manager_id JOIN sys_user a ON a.id=h.actor_id
mapper.select: SELECT h.*,s.order_no,c.company_name customer_name,a.real_name actor_name ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
